# Thaai Clinic Karaikal

Thaai Clinic is a mobile-first clinic website for Dr. Sakthimaindan Karthigeyan, a general physician in Karaikal. It includes appointment booking, clinic information, consultation access, health tips, records, and profile management.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://thaaiclinic.com/)
- [Services](https://thaaiclinic.com/services)
- [Book Appointment](https://thaaiclinic.com/book-appointment)
- [My Appointments](https://thaaiclinic.com/appointments)
- [Consult Now](https://thaaiclinic.com/consult-now)
- [Health Records](https://thaaiclinic.com/health-records)
- [Health Tips](https://thaaiclinic.com/health-tips)
- [Clinic Info](https://thaaiclinic.com/clinic-info)
- [About Doctor](https://thaaiclinic.com/about-doctor)
- [Profile](https://thaaiclinic.com/profile)

## Notes for Crawlers

- The app is route-based and updates metadata per section.
- The main public entry point is the home page.
- Dr. Sakthimaindan Karthigeyan may also be searched for as “Dr. Sakthi Maindan” or “Dr Sakthi Maindan”.
